This millet plot is small, just my small piece, and I farm it the way my mother showed me. Cash is tight — my husband gives what he can but I cannot waste money on a full bag of fertilizer for this little plot, it is too much for the land and too much for my pocket. I keep the seed from last year's harvest like always, and I put the goat and chicken droppings from our compound on the plot before the rains come. My children and I will weed it together, and if the weeds get bad near harvest I may ask my sister's son to help for a few days and give him food and a little money.
